faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee (IIT Roorkee), a premier educational institution in India, offering research opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post available in this recruitment drive is Junior Research Fellow, providing a valuable opportunity for candidates interested in research and development.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Roorkee, making it a competitive opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications for the Junior Research Fellow post is 26 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their application reaches the institute by this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply through offline mode for the Junior Research Fellow position. Detailed instructions for the application process are provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Tech in Environmental Engineering, preferably with relevant experience and a valid GATE scorecard, to be eligible for this research role.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected Junior Research Fellow will receive a salary of Rs. 37000 Per Month, along with HRA, as per the project norms and institutional guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Junior Research Fellow position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Junior Research Fellow at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow post primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for the Junior Research Fellow position is Roorkee, Uttarakhand, at the campus of the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee.
